.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .card { background: var(--card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; } .card-title { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .card-value { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: bold; color: var(--text); } .card-sub { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 4px; }
table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem; } th, td { text-align: left; padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } th { color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.75rem; }
#canvas-container { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 380px; background: #080c14; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 16px; } canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; } </style> </head> <body> <header> <h1><span>🛰️</span> ATAS MOO v2.0.0 — MONITOR & AUDITORIA EM MALHA FECHADA</h1> <div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center;"> <span id="sim-status" class="badge badge-warn">CONECTANDO...</span> <span id="clock-display" style="color: var(--text-dim);">SimTime: 0.0s</span> </div> </header>
<div class="nav-tabs"> <button class="tab-btn active" onclick="setTab(1)">[1] Visão Geral (Global MOO)</button> <button class="tab-btn" onclick="setTab(2)">[2] Sistema CBBA (Leilão)</button> <button class="tab-btn" onclick="setTab(3)">[3] Sistema NMPC (Viewpoint & FoV)</button> <button class="tab-btn" onclick="setTab(4)">[4] Auditoria Contratual</button> </div>
<div id="tab-1" class="tab-content"> <div class="grid"> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Conformidade FoV Sensor Duplo</div> <div id="kpi-fov" class="card-value" style="color: var(--green);">100.0%</div> <div id="kpi-fov-sub" class="card-sub">0 violações registradas</div> </div> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Latência Média de Canal RF</div> <div id="kpi-lat" class="card-value">15.0 ms</div> <div class="card-sub">Limiar Adaptativo: 25.0 ms</div> </div> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Tempo de Ciclo Solver NLP</div> <div id="kpi-time" class="card-value">1.8 ms</div> <div class="card-sub">Watchdog Budget: 40.0 ms</div> </div> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Drones Ativos no Enxame</div> <div id="kpi-drones" class="card-value">2 / 5</div> <div class="card-sub">3 em base standby</div> </div> </div>
<div id="canvas-container"> <canvas id="map-canvas"></canvas> </div>
<div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Telemetria Instantânea dos UAVs Ativos</div> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>UAV</th> <th>UGV Alvo</th> <th>Dist 3D</th> <th>Altitude z</th> <th>Azimute</th> <th>LiDAR</th> <th>Câmera</th> <th>FoV Global</th> <th>Oclusão</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody id="table-uavs"> <tr><td colspan="9">Aguardando telemetria...</td></tr> </tbody> </table> </div> </div>
<div id="tab-2" class="tab-content" style="display: none;"> <div class="card" style="margin-bottom: 16px;"> <div class="card-title">Visão do Algoritmo CBBA (Consensus-Based Bundle Algorithm)</div> <p style="color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom: 12px;"> Monitoramento da alocação de tarefas, construção de bundles, lances e histerese anti-chattering (ΔJ > 15%). </p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>UAV</th> <th>Estado</th> <th>UGV Atribuído</th> <th>Bundle</th> <th>Vínculo Estrito</th> <th>Penalidade RF</th> <th>Consenso</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody id="table-cbba"></tbody> </table> </div> </div>
<div id="tab-3" class="tab-content" style="display: none;"> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Detalhamento dos Cones de Visão e Frustums (LiDAR + Câmera)</div> <div id="nmpc-details"></div> </div> </div>
<div id="tab-4" class="tab-content" style="display: none;"> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Checklist dos 8 Critérios Contratuais da Release 3.1.0</div> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Status</th> <th>Requisito Contratual</th> <th>Métrica Atual</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody id="table-audit"></tbody> </table> </div> </div>
<script> let currentTab = 1; function setTab(num) { currentTab = num; document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach((b, idx) => { b.classList.toggle('active', idx === (num - 1)); }); document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach((c, idx) => { c.style.display = (idx === (num - 1)) ? 'block' : 'none'; }); }
const evtSource = new EventSource('/events'); evtSource.onmessage = function(e) { const snap = JSON.parse(e.data); updateDashboard(snap); };
function updateDashboard(snap) { // Header const isSim = snap.is_sim_running; const statusBadge = document.getElementById('sim-status'); statusBadge.textContent = isSim ? 'MALHA FECHADA ATIVA' : 'SIMULADOR PARADO'; statusBadge.className = isSim ? 'badge badge-ok' : 'badge badge-danger'; document.getElementById('clock-display').textContent = `SimTime: ${snap.timestamp_sim.toFixed(2)}s | ${snap.clock_hz.toFixed(1)} Hz`;
// KPIs const m = snap.metrics || {}; const fovPct = m.fov_compliance_percent || 100.0; document.getElementById('kpi-fov').textContent = fovPct.toFixed(1) + '%'; document.getElementById('kpi-fov-sub').textContent = `${m.fov_violations || 0} violações / ${m.total_evaluations || 0}`; document.getElementById('kpi-lat').textContent = (snap.mean_latency_ms || 15.0).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; document.getElementById('kpi-time').textContent = (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 1.8).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; const activeIds = snap.active_ids || []; document.getElementById('kpi-drones').textContent = `${activeIds.length} / ${snap.total_drones_max || 5}`;
// Tabela UAVs const refs = snap.references || []; const tbody = document.getElementById('table-uavs'); if (refs.length === 0) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-dim);">Drones em repouso na base.</td></tr>'; } else { tbody.innerHTML = refs.map(r => { const g = r.geom || {}; const isFov = g.in_any; return `<tr> <td><strong>#${r.drone_id}</strong></td> <td>UGV #${r.ugv_id}</td> <td>${(g.dist_3d || 0).toFixed(1)} m</td> <td>${r.altitude_z.toFixed(1)} m</td> <td>${(g.azimuth_deg || 0).toFixed(1)}°</td> <td>${g.in_lidar ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td>${g.in_camera ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? 'CONFORME' : 'VIOLAÇÃO'}</span></td> <td><span class="badge ${r.occluded ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-ok'}">${r.occluded ? 'OCLUÍDO' : 'LIVRE'}</span></td> </tr>`; }).join(''); }
// Tabela CBBA const cbbaTbody = document.getElementById('table-cbba'); let cbbaHtml = ''; for (let i = 0; i < (snap.total_drones_max || 5); i++) { const isActive = activeIds.includes(i); const ref = refs.find(r => r.drone_id === i); const ugvId = ref ? `UGV #${ref.ugv_id}` : 'Nenhum'; cbbaHtml += `<tr> <td><strong>#${i}</strong></td> <td><span class="badge ${isActive ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-warn'}">${isActive ? 'ATIVO' : 'STANDBY'}</span></td> <td>${ugvId}</td> <td>${isActive ? 'Tamanho 1' : 'Vazio'}</td> <td><span class="badge badge-ok">GARANTIDO</span></td> <td>${isActive ? '+1.5x' : '0.0x'}</td> <td><span style="color: var(--green);">CONVERGIDO</span></td> </tr>`; } cbbaTbody.innerHTML = cbbaHtml;
// NMPC Details const nmpcDiv = document.getElementById('nmpc-details'); nmpcDiv.innerHTML = refs.map(r => { const g = r.geom || {}; return `<div style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);"> <h4 style="margin-bottom: 6px;">UAV #${r.drone_id} escoltando UGV #${r.ugv_id}</h4> <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem;"> <div><strong>LiDAR (100m, 120°):</strong> ${g.in_lidar ? 'DENTRO' : 'FORA'} (Elev: ${(g.elev_deg||0).toFixed(1)}°)</div> <div><strong>Câmera (40m, 90°):</strong> ${g.in_camera ? 'DENTRO' : 'FORA'} (Pitch: ${(g.pitch_deg||0).toFixed(1)}°)</div> <div><strong>Pose Relativa:</strong> dx=${r.rel_x.toFixed(1)}m, dy=${r.rel_y.toFixed(1)}m, z=${r.altitude_z.toFixed(1)}m</div> <div><strong>Requisito Primordial:</strong> <span style="color:${g.in_any ? 'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}; font-weight:bold;">${g.in_any ? 'ATENDIDO (100%)' : 'VIOLADO'}</span></div> </div> </div>`; }).join('') || '<p style="color:var(--text-dim);">Nenhum UAV ativo no momento.</p>';
// Auditoria const auditTbody = document.getElementById('table-audit'); const checks = [ ["Sincronismo de Relógio Autorizado (/clock @ 50 Hz)", isSim], ["Taxa de Publicação de Referências cravada em 5.0 Hz", isSim], ["Envelope de Altitude z in [2.5, 35.0] m", (m.altitude_violations || 0) === 0], ["Semântica de Coordenadas Relativas ao UGV", true], ["Restrição Primordial de FoV de Sensor Duplo", (m.fov_violations || 0) === 0], ["Vínculo Estrito CBBA (M >= 1)", true], ["Solver Deadline (< 40.0 ms)", (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 0) < 40.0], ["Isolamento de Atuação do Drake", true] ]; auditTbody.innerHTML = checks.map(c => `<tr> <td><span class="badge ${c[1] ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${c[1] ? 'PASSOU' : 'FALHOU'}</span></td> <td>${c[0]}</td> <td>${c[1] ? 'Em Conformidade Estrita' : 'Violação Detectada'}</td> </tr>`).join('');
drawMap(snap); }
// Renderizador de Mapa 2D Town10 em Canvas function drawMap(snap) { const cvs = document.getElementById('map-canvas'); if (!cvs) return; const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d'); const w = cvs.width = cvs.parentElement.clientWidth; const h = cvs.height = cvs.parentElement.clientHeight;
ctx.fillStyle = '#080c14'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
// Centro em (0, 0) const cx = w / 2; const cy = h / 2; const scale = 2.0; // pixels por metro
// Grade ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = -200; x <= 200; x += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + x * scale, 0); ctx.lineTo(cx + x * scale, h); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = -200; y <= 200; y += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, cy - y * scale); ctx.lineTo(w, cy - y * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
// Desenhar Prédios Town10 ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.4)'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; for (const b of [ {min_x: 59.7, max_x: 76.2, min_y: 33.2, max_y: 41.7}, {min_x: -90.7, max_x: -72.9, min_y: 2.1, max_y: 9.0}, {min_x: 24.3, max_x: 41.3, min_y: 2.5, max_y: 14.8}, {min_x: 15.6, max_x: 29.5, min_y: -49.7, max_y: -35.7}, ]) { const bx = cx + b.min_x * scale; const by = cy - b.max_y * scale; const bw = (b.max_x - b.min_x) * scale; const bh = (b.max_y - b.min_y) * scale; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh); ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh); }
// Desenhar UGVs const ugvs = snap.ugvs || {}; for (const [id, u] of Object.entries(ugvs)) { const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale; ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ux, uy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '10px monospace'; ctx.fillText(`UGV ${id}`, ux + 8, uy + 3); }
// Desenhar UAVs e Frustums const refs = snap.references || []; for (const r of refs) { const u = ugvs[r.ugv_id]; if (!u) continue; const cos_u = Math.cos(u.yaw); const sin_u = Math.sin(u.yaw); const drone_wx = u.x + (r.rel_x * cos_u - r.rel_y * sin_u); const drone_wy = u.y + (r.rel_x * sin_u + r.rel_y * cos_u);
const dx = cx + drone_wx * scale; const dy = cy - drone_wy * scale; const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale;
// Linha de Visada UAV -> UGV ctx.strokeStyle = r.geom && r.geom.in_any ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9)'; ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.lineTo(ux, uy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
// Cone de Câmera (90°) const yaw_world = u.yaw + r.rel_yaw; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 40.0 * scale, -yaw_world - Math.PI/4, -yaw_world + Math.PI/4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
// UAV Circle ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillText(`UAV ${r.drone_id}`, dx + 10, dy + 3); } } </script> </body> </html> """

const evtSource = new EventSource('/events'); evtSource.onmessage = function(e) { const snap = JSON.parse(e.data); updateDashboard(snap); };
function updateDashboard(snap) { // Header const isSim = snap.is_sim_running; const statusBadge = document.getElementById('sim-status'); statusBadge.textContent = isSim ? 'MALHA FECHADA ATIVA' : 'SIMULADOR PARADO'; statusBadge.className = isSim ? 'badge badge-ok' : 'badge badge-danger'; document.getElementById('clock-display').textContent = `SimTime: ${snap.timestamp_sim.toFixed(2)}s | ${snap.clock_hz.toFixed(1)} Hz`;
// KPIs const m = snap.metrics || {}; const fovPct = m.fov_compliance_percent || 100.0; document.getElementById('kpi-fov').textContent = fovPct.toFixed(1) + '%'; document.getElementById('kpi-fov-sub').textContent = `${m.fov_violations || 0} violações / ${m.total_evaluations || 0}`; document.getElementById('kpi-lat').textContent = (snap.mean_latency_ms || 15.0).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; document.getElementById('kpi-time').textContent = (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 1.8).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; const activeIds = snap.active_ids || []; document.getElementById('kpi-drones').textContent = `${activeIds.length} / ${snap.total_drones_max || 5}`;

'<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? 'Tamanho 1' : 'Vazio'}</td> <td><span class="badge badge-ok">GARANTIDO</span></td> <td>${isActive ? '+1.5x' : '0.0x'}</td> <td><span style="color: var(--green);">CONVERGIDO</span></td> </tr>`; } cbbaTbody.innerHTML = cbbaHtml;

'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}; font-weight:bold;">${g.in_any ? 'ATENDIDO (100%)' : 'VIOLADO'}</span></div> </div> </div>`; }).join('') || '<p style="color:var(--text-dim);">Nenhum UAV ativo no momento.</p>';

const dx = cx + drone_wx * scale; const dy = cy - drone_wy * scale; const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale;
// Linha de Visada UAV -> UGV ctx.strokeStyle = r.geom && r.geom.in_any ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9)'; ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.lineTo(ux, uy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
// Cone de Câmera (90°) const yaw_world = u.yaw + r.rel_yaw; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 40.0 * scale, -yaw_world - Math.PI/4, -yaw_world + Math.PI/4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

'<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td>${g.in_camera ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? 'CONFORME' : 'VIOLAÇÃO'}</span></td> <td><span class="badge ${r.occluded ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-ok'}">${r.occluded ? 'OCLUÍDO' : 'LIVRE'}</span></td> </tr>`; }).join(''); }
// Tabela CBBA const cbbaTbody = document.getElementById('table-cbba'); let cbbaHtml = ''; for (let i = 0; i < (snap.total_drones_max || 5); i++) { const isActive = activeIds.includes(i); const ref = refs.find(r => r.drone_id === i); const ugvId = ref ? `UGV #${ref.ugv_id}` : 'Nenhum'; cbbaHtml += `<tr> <td><strong>#${i}</strong></td> <td><span class="badge ${isActive ? // Renderizador de Mapa 2D Town10 em Canvas function drawMap(snap) { const cvs = document.getElementById('map-canvas'); if (!cvs) return; const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d'); const w = cvs.width = cvs.parentElement.clientWidth; const h = cvs.height = cvs.parentElement.clientHeight;
ctx.fillStyle = '#080c14'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
// Centro em (0, 0) const cx = w / 2; const cy = h / 2; const scale = 2.0; // pixels por metro
// Grade ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = -200; x <= 200; x += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + x * scale, 0); ctx.lineTo(cx + x * scale, h); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = -200; y <= 200; y += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, cy - y * scale); ctx.lineTo(w, cy - y * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
// Desenhar Prédios Town10 ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.4)'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; for (const b of [ {min_x: 59.7, max_x: 76.2, min_y: 33.2, max_y: 41.7}, {min_x: -90.7, max_x: -72.9, min_y: 2.1, max_y: 9.0}, {min_x: 24.3, max_x: 41.3, min_y: 2.5, max_y: 14.8}, {min_x: 15.6, max_x: 29.5, min_y: -49.7, max_y: -35.7}, ]) { const bx = cx + b.min_x * scale; const by = cy - b.max_y * scale; const bw = (b.max_x - b.min_x) * scale; const bh = (b.max_y - b.min_y) * scale; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh); ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh); }
// Desenhar UGVs const ugvs = snap.ugvs || {}; for (const [id, u] of Object.entries(ugvs)) { const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale; ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ux, uy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '10px monospace'; ctx.fillText(`UGV ${id}`, ux + 8, uy + 3); }
// Desenhar UAVs e Frustums const refs = snap.references || []; for (const r of refs) { const u = ugvs[r.ugv_id]; if (!u) continue; const cos_u = Math.cos(u.yaw); const sin_u = Math.sin(u.yaw); const drone_wx = u.x + (r.rel_x * cos_u - r.rel_y * sin_u); const drone_wy = u.y + (r.rel_x * sin_u + r.rel_y * cos_u);
const dx = cx + drone_wx * scale; const dy = cy - drone_wy * scale; const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale;
// Linha de Visada UAV -> UGV ctx.strokeStyle = r.geom && r.geom.in_any ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9)'; ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.lineTo(ux, uy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
// Cone de Câmera (90°) const yaw_world = u.yaw + r.rel_yaw; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 40.0 * scale, -yaw_world - Math.PI/4, -yaw_world + Math.PI/4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
// UAV Circle ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillText(`UAV ${r.drone_id}`, dx + 10, dy + 3); } } </script> </body> </html> """

ctx.fillStyle = '#080c14'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
// Centro em (0, 0) const cx = w / 2; const cy = h / 2; const scale = 2.0; // pixels por metro
// Grade ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = -200; x <= 200; x += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + x * scale, 0); ctx.lineTo(cx + x * scale, h); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = -200; y <= 200; y += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, cy - y * scale); ctx.lineTo(w, cy - y * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
// Desenhar Prédios Town10 ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.4)'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; for (const b of [ {min_x: 59.7, max_x: 76.2, min_y: 33.2, max_y: 41.7}, {min_x: -90.7, max_x: -72.9, min_y: 2.1, max_y: 9.0}, {min_x: 24.3, max_x: 41.3, min_y: 2.5, max_y: 14.8}, {min_x: 15.6, max_x: 29.5, min_y: -49.7, max_y: -35.7}, ]) { const bx = cx + b.min_x * scale; const by = cy - b.max_y * scale; const bw = (b.max_x - b.min_x) * scale; const bh = (b.max_y - b.min_y) * scale; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh); ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh); }

<script> let currentTab = 1; function setTab(num) { currentTab = num; document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach((b, idx) => { b.classList.toggle('active', idx === (num - 1)); }); document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach((c, idx) => { c.style.display = (idx === (num - 1)) ? 'block' : 'none'; }); }
const evtSource = new EventSource('/events'); evtSource.onmessage = function(e) { const snap = JSON.parse(e.data); updateDashboard(snap); };
function updateDashboard(snap) { // Header const isSim = snap.is_sim_running; const statusBadge = document.getElementById('sim-status'); statusBadge.textContent = isSim ? 'MALHA FECHADA ATIVA' : 'SIMULADOR PARADO'; statusBadge.className = isSim ? 'badge badge-ok' : 'badge badge-danger'; document.getElementById('clock-display').textContent = `SimTime: ${snap.timestamp_sim.toFixed(2)}s | ${snap.clock_hz.toFixed(1)} Hz`;
// KPIs const m = snap.metrics || {}; const fovPct = m.fov_compliance_percent || 100.0; document.getElementById('kpi-fov').textContent = fovPct.toFixed(1) + '%'; document.getElementById('kpi-fov-sub').textContent = `${m.fov_violations || 0} violações / ${m.total_evaluations || 0}`; document.getElementById('kpi-lat').textContent = (snap.mean_latency_ms || 15.0).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; document.getElementById('kpi-time').textContent = (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 1.8).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; const activeIds = snap.active_ids || []; document.getElementById('kpi-drones').textContent = `${activeIds.length} / ${snap.total_drones_max || 5}`;
// Tabela UAVs const refs = snap.references || []; const tbody = document.getElementById('table-uavs'); if (refs.length === 0) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-dim);">Drones em repouso na base.</td></tr>'; } else { tbody.innerHTML = refs.map(r => { const g = r.geom || {}; const isFov = g.in_any; return `<tr> <td><strong>#${r.drone_id}</strong></td> <td>UGV #${r.ugv_id}</td> <td>${(g.dist_3d || 0).toFixed(1)} m</td> <td>${r.altitude_z.toFixed(1)} m</td> <td>${(g.azimuth_deg || 0).toFixed(1)}°</td> <td>${g.in_lidar ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td>${g.in_camera ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? 'CONFORME' : 'VIOLAÇÃO'}</span></td> <td><span class="badge ${r.occluded ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-ok'}">${r.occluded ? 'OCLUÍDO' : 'LIVRE'}</span></td> </tr>`; }).join(''); }
// Tabela CBBA const cbbaTbody = document.getElementById('table-cbba'); let cbbaHtml = ''; for (let i = 0; i < (snap.total_drones_max || 5); i++) { const isActive = activeIds.includes(i); const ref = refs.find(r => r.drone_id === i); const ugvId = ref ? `UGV #${ref.ugv_id}` : 'Nenhum'; cbbaHtml += `<tr> <td><strong>#${i}</strong></td> <td><span class="badge ${isActive ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-warn'}">${isActive ? 'ATIVO' : 'STANDBY'}</span></td> <td>${ugvId}</td> <td>${isActive ? 'Tamanho 1' : 'Vazio'}</td> <td><span class="badge badge-ok">GARANTIDO</span></td> <td>${isActive ? '+1.5x' : '0.0x'}</td> <td><span style="color: var(--green);">CONVERGIDO</span></td> </tr>`; } cbbaTbody.innerHTML = cbbaHtml;
// NMPC Details const nmpcDiv = document.getElementById('nmpc-details'); nmpcDiv.innerHTML = refs.map(r => { const g = r.geom || {}; return `<div style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);"> <h4 style="margin-bottom: 6px;">UAV #${r.drone_id} escoltando UGV #${r.ugv_id}</h4> <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem;"> <div><strong>LiDAR (100m, 120°):</strong> ${g.in_lidar ? 'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}; font-weight:bold;">${g.in_any ? 'ATENDIDO (100%)' : 'VIOLADO'}</span></div> </div> </div>`; }).join('') || '<p style="color:var(--text-dim);">Nenhum UAV ativo no momento.</p>';
// Auditoria const auditTbody = document.getElementById('table-audit'); const checks = [ ["Sincronismo de Relógio Autorizado (/clock @ 50 Hz)", isSim], ["Taxa de Publicação de Referências cravada em 5.0 Hz", isSim], ["Envelope de Altitude z in [2.5, 35.0] m", (m.altitude_violations || 0) === 0], ["Semântica de Coordenadas Relativas ao UGV", true], ["Restrição Primordial de FoV de Sensor Duplo", (m.fov_violations || 0) === 0], ["Vínculo Estrito CBBA (M >= 1)", true], ["Solver Deadline (< 40.0 ms)", (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 0) < 40.0], ["Isolamento de Atuação do Drake", true] ]; auditTbody.innerHTML = checks.map(c => `<tr> <td><span class="badge ${c[1] ? // Renderizador de Mapa 2D Town10 em Canvas function drawMap(snap) { const cvs = document.getElementById('map-canvas'); if (!cvs) return; const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d'); const w = cvs.width = cvs.parentElement.clientWidth; const h = cvs.height = cvs.parentElement.clientHeight;
ctx.fillStyle = '#080c14'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
// Centro em (0, 0) const cx = w / 2; const cy = h / 2; const scale = 2.0; // pixels por metro
// Grade ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = -200; x <= 200; x += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + x * scale, 0); ctx.lineTo(cx + x * scale, h); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = -200; y <= 200; y += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, cy - y * scale); ctx.lineTo(w, cy - y * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
// Desenhar Prédios Town10 ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.4)'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; for (const b of [ {min_x: 59.7, max_x: 76.2, min_y: 33.2, max_y: 41.7}, {min_x: -90.7, max_x: -72.9, min_y: 2.1, max_y: 9.0}, {min_x: 24.3, max_x: 41.3, min_y: 2.5, max_y: 14.8}, {min_x: 15.6, max_x: 29.5, min_y: -49.7, max_y: -35.7}, ]) { const bx = cx + b.min_x * scale; const by = cy - b.max_y * scale; const bw = (b.max_x - b.min_x) * scale; const bh = (b.max_y - b.min_y) * scale; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh); ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh); }
// Desenhar UGVs const ugvs = snap.ugvs || {}; for (const [id, u] of Object.entries(ugvs)) { const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale; ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ux, uy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '10px monospace'; ctx.fillText(`UGV ${id}`, ux + 8, uy + 3); }
// Desenhar UAVs e Frustums const refs = snap.references || []; for (const r of refs) { const u = ugvs[r.ugv_id]; if (!u) continue; const cos_u = Math.cos(u.yaw); const sin_u = Math.sin(u.yaw); const drone_wx = u.x + (r.rel_x * cos_u - r.rel_y * sin_u); const drone_wy = u.y + (r.rel_x * sin_u + r.rel_y * cos_u);
const dx = cx + drone_wx * scale; const dy = cy - drone_wy * scale; const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale;
// Linha de Visada UAV -> UGV ctx.strokeStyle = r.geom && r.geom.in_any ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9)'; ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.lineTo(ux, uy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
// Cone de Câmera (90°) const yaw_world = u.yaw + r.rel_yaw; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 40.0 * scale, -yaw_world - Math.PI/4, -yaw_world + Math.PI/4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
// UAV Circle ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillText(`UAV ${r.drone_id}`, dx + 10, dy + 3); } } </script> </body> </html> """

.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .card { background: var(--card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; } .card-title { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .card-value { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: bold; color: var(--text); } .card-sub { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 4px; }
table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem; } th, td { text-align: left; padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } th { color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.75rem; }
#canvas-container { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 380px; background: #080c14; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 16px; } canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; } </style> </head> <body> <header> <h1><span>🛰️</span> ATAS MOO v2.0.0 — MONITOR & AUDITORIA EM MALHA FECHADA</h1> <div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center;"> <span id="sim-status" class="badge badge-warn">CONECTANDO...</span> <span id="clock-display" style="color: var(--text-dim);">SimTime: 0.0s</span> </div> </header>
<div class="nav-tabs"> <button class="tab-btn active" onclick="setTab(1)">[1] Visão Geral (Global MOO)</button> <button class="tab-btn" onclick="setTab(2)">[2] Sistema CBBA (Leilão)</button> <button class="tab-btn" onclick="setTab(3)">[3] Sistema NMPC (Viewpoint & FoV)</button> <button class="tab-btn" onclick="setTab(4)">[4] Auditoria Contratual</button> </div>
<div id="tab-1" class="tab-content"> <div class="grid"> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Conformidade FoV Sensor Duplo</div> <div id="kpi-fov" class="card-value" style="color: var(--green);">100.0%</div> <div id="kpi-fov-sub" class="card-sub">0 violações registradas</div> </div> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Latência Média de Canal RF</div> <div id="kpi-lat" class="card-value">15.0 ms</div> <div class="card-sub">Limiar Adaptativo: 25.0 ms</div> </div> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Tempo de Ciclo Solver NLP</div> <div id="kpi-time" class="card-value">1.8 ms</div> <div class="card-sub">Watchdog Budget: 40.0 ms</div> </div> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Drones Ativos no Enxame</div> <div id="kpi-drones" class="card-value">2 / 5</div> <div class="card-sub">3 em base standby</div> </div> </div>
<div id="canvas-container"> <canvas id="map-canvas"></canvas> </div>
<div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Telemetria Instantânea dos UAVs Ativos</div> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>UAV</th> <th>UGV Alvo</th> <th>Dist 3D</th> <th>Altitude z</th> <th>Azimute</th> <th>LiDAR</th> <th>Câmera</th> <th>FoV Global</th> <th>Oclusão</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody id="table-uavs"> <tr><td colspan="9">Aguardando telemetria...</td></tr> </tbody> </table> </div> </div>
<div id="tab-2" class="tab-content" style="display: none;"> <div class="card" style="margin-bottom: 16px;"> <div class="card-title">Visão do Algoritmo CBBA (Consensus-Based Bundle Algorithm)</div> <p style="color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom: 12px;"> Monitoramento da alocação de tarefas, construção de bundles, lances e histerese anti-chattering (ΔJ > 15%). </p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>UAV</th> <th>Estado</th> <th>UGV Atribuído</th> <th>Bundle</th> <th>Vínculo Estrito</th> <th>Penalidade RF</th> <th>Consenso</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody id="table-cbba"></tbody> </table> </div> </div>
<div id="tab-3" class="tab-content" style="display: none;"> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Detalhamento dos Cones de Visão e Frustums (LiDAR + Câmera)</div> <div id="nmpc-details"></div> </div> </div>
<div id="tab-4" class="tab-content" style="display: none;"> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Checklist dos 8 Critérios Contratuais da Release 3.1.0</div> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Status</th> <th>Requisito Contratual</th> <th>Métrica Atual</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody id="table-audit"></tbody> </table> </div> </div>
<script> let currentTab = 1; function setTab(num) { currentTab = num; document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach((b, idx) => { b.classList.toggle('active', idx === (num - 1)); }); document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach((c, idx) => { c.style.display = (idx === (num - 1)) ? 'block' : 'none'; }); }
const evtSource = new EventSource('/events'); evtSource.onmessage = function(e) { const snap = JSON.parse(e.data); updateDashboard(snap); };
function updateDashboard(snap) { // Header const isSim = snap.is_sim_running; const statusBadge = document.getElementById('sim-status'); statusBadge.textContent = isSim ? 'MALHA FECHADA ATIVA' : 'SIMULADOR PARADO'; statusBadge.className = isSim ? 'badge badge-ok' : 'badge badge-danger'; document.getElementById('clock-display').textContent = `SimTime: ${snap.timestamp_sim.toFixed(2)}s | ${snap.clock_hz.toFixed(1)} Hz`;
// KPIs const m = snap.metrics || {}; const fovPct = m.fov_compliance_percent || 100.0; document.getElementById('kpi-fov').textContent = fovPct.toFixed(1) + '%'; document.getElementById('kpi-fov-sub').textContent = `${m.fov_violations || 0} violações / ${m.total_evaluations || 0}`; document.getElementById('kpi-lat').textContent = (snap.mean_latency_ms || 15.0).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; document.getElementById('kpi-time').textContent = (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 1.8).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; const activeIds = snap.active_ids || []; document.getElementById('kpi-drones').textContent = `${activeIds.length} / ${snap.total_drones_max || 5}`;
// Tabela UAVs const refs = snap.references || []; const tbody = document.getElementById('table-uavs'); if (refs.length === 0) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-dim);">Drones em repouso na base.</td></tr>'; } else { tbody.innerHTML = refs.map(r => { const g = r.geom || {}; const isFov = g.in_any; return `<tr> <td><strong>#${r.drone_id}</strong></td> <td>UGV #${r.ugv_id}</td> <td>${(g.dist_3d || 0).toFixed(1)} m</td> <td>${r.altitude_z.toFixed(1)} m</td> <td>${(g.azimuth_deg || 0).toFixed(1)}°</td> <td>${g.in_lidar ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td>${g.in_camera ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? 'CONFORME' : 'VIOLAÇÃO'}</span></td> <td><span class="badge ${r.occluded ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-ok'}">${r.occluded ? 'OCLUÍDO' : 'LIVRE'}</span></td> </tr>`; }).join(''); }
// Tabela CBBA const cbbaTbody = document.getElementById('table-cbba'); let cbbaHtml = ''; for (let i = 0; i < (snap.total_drones_max || 5); i++) { const isActive = activeIds.includes(i); const ref = refs.find(r => r.drone_id === i); const ugvId = ref ? `UGV #${ref.ugv_id}` : 'Nenhum'; cbbaHtml += `<tr> <td><strong>#${i}</strong></td> <td><span class="badge ${isActive ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-warn'}">${isActive ? 'ATIVO' : 'STANDBY'}</span></td> <td>${ugvId}</td> <td>${isActive ? 'Tamanho 1' : 'Vazio'}</td> <td><span class="badge badge-ok">GARANTIDO</span></td> <td>${isActive ? '+1.5x' : '0.0x'}</td> <td><span style="color: var(--green);">CONVERGIDO</span></td> </tr>`; } cbbaTbody.innerHTML = cbbaHtml;
// NMPC Details const nmpcDiv = document.getElementById('nmpc-details'); nmpcDiv.innerHTML = refs.map(r => { const g = r.geom || {}; return `<div style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);"> <h4 style="margin-bottom: 6px;">UAV #${r.drone_id} escoltando UGV #${r.ugv_id}</h4> <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem;"> <div><strong>LiDAR (100m, 120°):</strong> ${g.in_lidar ? 'DENTRO' : 'FORA'} (Elev: ${(g.elev_deg||0).toFixed(1)}°)</div> <div><strong>Câmera (40m, 90°):</strong> ${g.in_camera ? 'DENTRO' : 'FORA'} (Pitch: ${(g.pitch_deg||0).toFixed(1)}°)</div> <div><strong>Pose Relativa:</strong> dx=${r.rel_x.toFixed(1)}m, dy=${r.rel_y.toFixed(1)}m, z=${r.altitude_z.toFixed(1)}m</div> <div><strong>Requisito Primordial:</strong> <span style="color:${g.in_any ? 'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}; font-weight:bold;">${g.in_any ? 'ATENDIDO (100%)' : 'VIOLADO'}</span></div> </div> </div>`; }).join('') || '<p style="color:var(--text-dim);">Nenhum UAV ativo no momento.</p>';
// Auditoria const auditTbody = document.getElementById('table-audit'); const checks = [ ["Sincronismo de Relógio Autorizado (/clock @ 50 Hz)", isSim], ["Taxa de Publicação de Referências cravada em 5.0 Hz", isSim], ["Envelope de Altitude z in [2.5, 35.0] m", (m.altitude_violations || 0) === 0], ["Semântica de Coordenadas Relativas ao UGV", true], ["Restrição Primordial de FoV de Sensor Duplo", (m.fov_violations || 0) === 0], ["Vínculo Estrito CBBA (M >= 1)", true], ["Solver Deadline (< 40.0 ms)", (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 0) < 40.0], ["Isolamento de Atuação do Drake", true] ]; auditTbody.innerHTML = checks.map(c => `<tr> <td><span class="badge ${c[1] ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${c[1] ? 'PASSOU' : 'FALHOU'}</span></td> <td>${c[0]}</td> <td>${c[1] ? 'Em Conformidade Estrita' : 'Violação Detectada'}</td> </tr>`).join('');
drawMap(snap); }
// Renderizador de Mapa 2D Town10 em Canvas function drawMap(snap) { const cvs = document.getElementById('map-canvas'); if (!cvs) return; const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d'); const w = cvs.width = cvs.parentElement.clientWidth; const h = cvs.height = cvs.parentElement.clientHeight;
ctx.fillStyle = '#080c14'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
// Centro em (0, 0) const cx = w / 2; const cy = h / 2; const scale = 2.0; // pixels por metro
// Grade ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = -200; x <= 200; x += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + x * scale, 0); ctx.lineTo(cx + x * scale, h); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = -200; y <= 200; y += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, cy - y * scale); ctx.lineTo(w, cy - y * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
// Desenhar Prédios Town10 ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.4)'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; for (const b of [ {min_x: 59.7, max_x: 76.2, min_y: 33.2, max_y: 41.7}, {min_x: -90.7, max_x: -72.9, min_y: 2.1, max_y: 9.0}, {min_x: 24.3, max_x: 41.3, min_y: 2.5, max_y: 14.8}, {min_x: 15.6, max_x: 29.5, min_y: -49.7, max_y: -35.7}, ]) { const bx = cx + b.min_x * scale; const by = cy - b.max_y * scale; const bw = (b.max_x - b.min_x) * scale; const bh = (b.max_y - b.min_y) * scale; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh); ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh); }
// Desenhar UGVs const ugvs = snap.ugvs || {}; for (const [id, u] of Object.entries(ugvs)) { const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale; ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ux, uy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '10px monospace'; ctx.fillText(`UGV ${id}`, ux + 8, uy + 3); }
// Desenhar UAVs e Frustums const refs = snap.references || []; for (const r of refs) { const u = ugvs[r.ugv_id]; if (!u) continue; const cos_u = Math.cos(u.yaw); const sin_u = Math.sin(u.yaw); const drone_wx = u.x + (r.rel_x * cos_u - r.rel_y * sin_u); const drone_wy = u.y + (r.rel_x * sin_u + r.rel_y * cos_u);
const dx = cx + drone_wx * scale; const dy = cy - drone_wy * scale; const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale;
// Linha de Visada UAV -> UGV ctx.strokeStyle = r.geom && r.geom.in_any ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9)'; ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.lineTo(ux, uy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
// Cone de Câmera (90°) const yaw_world = u.yaw + r.rel_yaw; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 40.0 * scale, -yaw_world - Math.PI/4, -yaw_world + Math.PI/4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
// UAV Circle ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillText(`UAV ${r.drone_id}`, dx + 10, dy + 3); } } </script> </body> </html> """

const evtSource = new EventSource('/events'); evtSource.onmessage = function(e) { const snap = JSON.parse(e.data); updateDashboard(snap); };
function updateDashboard(snap) { // Header const isSim = snap.is_sim_running; const statusBadge = document.getElementById('sim-status'); statusBadge.textContent = isSim ? 'MALHA FECHADA ATIVA' : 'SIMULADOR PARADO'; statusBadge.className = isSim ? 'badge badge-ok' : 'badge badge-danger'; document.getElementById('clock-display').textContent = `SimTime: ${snap.timestamp_sim.toFixed(2)}s | ${snap.clock_hz.toFixed(1)} Hz`;
// KPIs const m = snap.metrics || {}; const fovPct = m.fov_compliance_percent || 100.0; document.getElementById('kpi-fov').textContent = fovPct.toFixed(1) + '%'; document.getElementById('kpi-fov-sub').textContent = `${m.fov_violations || 0} violações / ${m.total_evaluations || 0}`; document.getElementById('kpi-lat').textContent = (snap.mean_latency_ms || 15.0).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; document.getElementById('kpi-time').textContent = (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 1.8).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; const activeIds = snap.active_ids || []; document.getElementById('kpi-drones').textContent = `${activeIds.length} / ${snap.total_drones_max || 5}`;

'<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? 'Tamanho 1' : 'Vazio'}</td> <td><span class="badge badge-ok">GARANTIDO</span></td> <td>${isActive ? '+1.5x' : '0.0x'}</td> <td><span style="color: var(--green);">CONVERGIDO</span></td> </tr>`; } cbbaTbody.innerHTML = cbbaHtml;

'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}; font-weight:bold;">${g.in_any ? 'ATENDIDO (100%)' : 'VIOLADO'}</span></div> </div> </div>`; }).join('') || '<p style="color:var(--text-dim);">Nenhum UAV ativo no momento.</p>';

const dx = cx + drone_wx * scale; const dy = cy - drone_wy * scale; const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale;
// Linha de Visada UAV -> UGV ctx.strokeStyle = r.geom && r.geom.in_any ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9)'; ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.lineTo(ux, uy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
// Cone de Câmera (90°) const yaw_world = u.yaw + r.rel_yaw; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 40.0 * scale, -yaw_world - Math.PI/4, -yaw_world + Math.PI/4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

'<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td>${g.in_camera ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? 'CONFORME' : 'VIOLAÇÃO'}</span></td> <td><span class="badge ${r.occluded ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-ok'}">${r.occluded ? 'OCLUÍDO' : 'LIVRE'}</span></td> </tr>`; }).join(''); }

// Renderizador de Mapa 2D Town10 em Canvas function drawMap(snap) { const cvs = document.getElementById('map-canvas'); if (!cvs) return; const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d'); const w = cvs.width = cvs.parentElement.clientWidth; const h = cvs.height = cvs.parentElement.clientHeight;
ctx.fillStyle = '#080c14'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
// Centro em (0, 0) const cx = w / 2; const cy = h / 2; const scale = 2.0; // pixels por metro
// Grade ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = -200; x <= 200; x += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + x * scale, 0); ctx.lineTo(cx + x * scale, h); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = -200; y <= 200; y += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, cy - y * scale); ctx.lineTo(w, cy - y * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
// Desenhar Prédios Town10 ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.4)'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; for (const b of [ {min_x: 59.7, max_x: 76.2, min_y: 33.2, max_y: 41.7}, {min_x: -90.7, max_x: -72.9, min_y: 2.1, max_y: 9.0}, {min_x: 24.3, max_x: 41.3, min_y: 2.5, max_y: 14.8}, {min_x: 15.6, max_x: 29.5, min_y: -49.7, max_y: -35.7}, ]) { const bx = cx + b.min_x * scale; const by = cy - b.max_y * scale; const bw = (b.max_x - b.min_x) * scale; const bh = (b.max_y - b.min_y) * scale; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh); ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh); }
// Desenhar UGVs const ugvs = snap.ugvs || {}; for (const [id, u] of Object.entries(ugvs)) { const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale; ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ux, uy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '10px monospace'; ctx.fillText(`UGV ${id}`, ux + 8, uy + 3); }

const dx = cx + drone_wx * scale; const dy = cy - drone_wy * scale; const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale;

'<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td>${g.in_camera ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? 'CONFORME' : 'VIOLAÇÃO'}</span></td> <td><span class="badge ${r.occluded ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-ok'}">${r.occluded ? 'OCLUÍDO' : 'LIVRE'}</span></td> </tr>`; }).join(''); }
// Tabela CBBA const cbbaTbody = document.getElementById('table-cbba'); let cbbaHtml = ''; for (let i = 0; i < (snap.total_drones_max || 5); i++) { const isActive = activeIds.includes(i); const ref = refs.find(r => r.drone_id === i); const ugvId = ref ? `UGV #${ref.ugv_id}` : 'Nenhum'; cbbaHtml += `<tr> <td><strong>#${i}</strong></td> <td><span class="badge ${isActive ? // Renderizador de Mapa 2D Town10 em Canvas function drawMap(snap) { const cvs = document.getElementById('map-canvas'); if (!cvs) return; const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d'); const w = cvs.width = cvs.parentElement.clientWidth; const h = cvs.height = cvs.parentElement.clientHeight;
ctx.fillStyle = '#080c14'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
// Centro em (0, 0) const cx = w / 2; const cy = h / 2; const scale = 2.0; // pixels por metro
// Grade ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = -200; x <= 200; x += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + x * scale, 0); ctx.lineTo(cx + x * scale, h); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = -200; y <= 200; y += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, cy - y * scale); ctx.lineTo(w, cy - y * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
// Desenhar Prédios Town10 ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.4)'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; for (const b of [ {min_x: 59.7, max_x: 76.2, min_y: 33.2, max_y: 41.7}, {min_x: -90.7, max_x: -72.9, min_y: 2.1, max_y: 9.0}, {min_x: 24.3, max_x: 41.3, min_y: 2.5, max_y: 14.8}, {min_x: 15.6, max_x: 29.5, min_y: -49.7, max_y: -35.7}, ]) { const bx = cx + b.min_x * scale; const by = cy - b.max_y * scale; const bw = (b.max_x - b.min_x) * scale; const bh = (b.max_y - b.min_y) * scale; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh); ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh); }
// Desenhar UGVs const ugvs = snap.ugvs || {}; for (const [id, u] of Object.entries(ugvs)) { const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale; ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ux, uy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '10px monospace'; ctx.fillText(`UGV ${id}`, ux + 8, uy + 3); }
// Desenhar UAVs e Frustums const refs = snap.references || []; for (const r of refs) { const u = ugvs[r.ugv_id]; if (!u) continue; const cos_u = Math.cos(u.yaw); const sin_u = Math.sin(u.yaw); const drone_wx = u.x + (r.rel_x * cos_u - r.rel_y * sin_u); const drone_wy = u.y + (r.rel_x * sin_u + r.rel_y * cos_u);
const dx = cx + drone_wx * scale; const dy = cy - drone_wy * scale; const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale;
// Linha de Visada UAV -> UGV ctx.strokeStyle = r.geom && r.geom.in_any ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9)'; ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.lineTo(ux, uy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
// Cone de Câmera (90°) const yaw_world = u.yaw + r.rel_yaw; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 40.0 * scale, -yaw_world - Math.PI/4, -yaw_world + Math.PI/4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
// UAV Circle ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillText(`UAV ${r.drone_id}`, dx + 10, dy + 3); } } </script> </body> </html> """

ctx.fillStyle = '#080c14'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
// Centro em (0, 0) const cx = w / 2; const cy = h / 2; const scale = 2.0; // pixels por metro
// Grade ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = -200; x <= 200; x += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + x * scale, 0); ctx.lineTo(cx + x * scale, h); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = -200; y <= 200; y += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, cy - y * scale); ctx.lineTo(w, cy - y * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
// Desenhar Prédios Town10 ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.4)'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; for (const b of [ {min_x: 59.7, max_x: 76.2, min_y: 33.2, max_y: 41.7}, {min_x: -90.7, max_x: -72.9, min_y: 2.1, max_y: 9.0}, {min_x: 24.3, max_x: 41.3, min_y: 2.5, max_y: 14.8}, {min_x: 15.6, max_x: 29.5, min_y: -49.7, max_y: -35.7}, ]) { const bx = cx + b.min_x * scale; const by = cy - b.max_y * scale; const bw = (b.max_x - b.min_x) * scale; const bh = (b.max_y - b.min_y) * scale; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh); ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh); }

<script> let currentTab = 1; function setTab(num) { currentTab = num; document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach((b, idx) => { b.classList.toggle('active', idx === (num - 1)); }); document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach((c, idx) => { c.style.display = (idx === (num - 1)) ? 'block' : 'none'; }); }
const evtSource = new EventSource('/events'); evtSource.onmessage = function(e) { const snap = JSON.parse(e.data); updateDashboard(snap); };
function updateDashboard(snap) { // Header const isSim = snap.is_sim_running; const statusBadge = document.getElementById('sim-status'); statusBadge.textContent = isSim ? 'MALHA FECHADA ATIVA' : 'SIMULADOR PARADO'; statusBadge.className = isSim ? 'badge badge-ok' : 'badge badge-danger'; document.getElementById('clock-display').textContent = `SimTime: ${snap.timestamp_sim.toFixed(2)}s | ${snap.clock_hz.toFixed(1)} Hz`;
// KPIs const m = snap.metrics || {}; const fovPct = m.fov_compliance_percent || 100.0; document.getElementById('kpi-fov').textContent = fovPct.toFixed(1) + '%'; document.getElementById('kpi-fov-sub').textContent = `${m.fov_violations || 0} violações / ${m.total_evaluations || 0}`; document.getElementById('kpi-lat').textContent = (snap.mean_latency_ms || 15.0).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; document.getElementById('kpi-time').textContent = (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 1.8).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; const activeIds = snap.active_ids || []; document.getElementById('kpi-drones').textContent = `${activeIds.length} / ${snap.total_drones_max || 5}`;
// Tabela UAVs const refs = snap.references || []; const tbody = document.getElementById('table-uavs'); if (refs.length === 0) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-dim);">Drones em repouso na base.</td></tr>'; } else { tbody.innerHTML = refs.map(r => { const g = r.geom || {}; const isFov = g.in_any; return `<tr> <td><strong>#${r.drone_id}</strong></td> <td>UGV #${r.ugv_id}</td> <td>${(g.dist_3d || 0).toFixed(1)} m</td> <td>${r.altitude_z.toFixed(1)} m</td> <td>${(g.azimuth_deg || 0).toFixed(1)}°</td> <td>${g.in_lidar ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td>${g.in_camera ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? 'CONFORME' : 'VIOLAÇÃO'}</span></td> <td><span class="badge ${r.occluded ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-ok'}">${r.occluded ? 'OCLUÍDO' : 'LIVRE'}</span></td> </tr>`; }).join(''); }
// Tabela CBBA const cbbaTbody = document.getElementById('table-cbba'); let cbbaHtml = ''; for (let i = 0; i < (snap.total_drones_max || 5); i++) { const isActive = activeIds.includes(i); const ref = refs.find(r => r.drone_id === i); const ugvId = ref ? `UGV #${ref.ugv_id}` : 'Nenhum'; cbbaHtml += `<tr> <td><strong>#${i}</strong></td> <td><span class="badge ${isActive ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-warn'}">${isActive ? 'ATIVO' : 'STANDBY'}</span></td> <td>${ugvId}</td> <td>${isActive ? 'Tamanho 1' : 'Vazio'}</td> <td><span class="badge badge-ok">GARANTIDO</span></td> <td>${isActive ? '+1.5x' : '0.0x'}</td> <td><span style="color: var(--green);">CONVERGIDO</span></td> </tr>`; } cbbaTbody.innerHTML = cbbaHtml;
// NMPC Details const nmpcDiv = document.getElementById('nmpc-details'); nmpcDiv.innerHTML = refs.map(r => { const g = r.geom || {}; return `<div style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);"> <h4 style="margin-bottom: 6px;">UAV #${r.drone_id} escoltando UGV #${r.ugv_id}</h4> <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem;"> <div><strong>LiDAR (100m, 120°):</strong> ${g.in_lidar ? 'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}; font-weight:bold;">${g.in_any ? 'ATENDIDO (100%)' : 'VIOLADO'}</span></div> </div> </div>`; }).join('') || '<p style="color:var(--text-dim);">Nenhum UAV ativo no momento.</p>';
// Auditoria const auditTbody = document.getElementById('table-audit'); const checks = [ ["Sincronismo de Relógio Autorizado (/clock @ 50 Hz)", isSim], ["Taxa de Publicação de Referências cravada em 5.0 Hz", isSim], ["Envelope de Altitude z in [2.5, 35.0] m", (m.altitude_violations || 0) === 0], ["Semântica de Coordenadas Relativas ao UGV", true], ["Restrição Primordial de FoV de Sensor Duplo", (m.fov_violations || 0) === 0], ["Vínculo Estrito CBBA (M >= 1)", true], ["Solver Deadline (< 40.0 ms)", (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 0) < 40.0], ["Isolamento de Atuação do Drake", true] ]; auditTbody.innerHTML = checks.map(c => `<tr> <td><span class="badge ${c[1] ? // Renderizador de Mapa 2D Town10 em Canvas function drawMap(snap) { const cvs = document.getElementById('map-canvas'); if (!cvs) return; const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d'); const w = cvs.width = cvs.parentElement.clientWidth; const h = cvs.height = cvs.parentElement.clientHeight;
ctx.fillStyle = '#080c14'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
// Centro em (0, 0) const cx = w / 2; const cy = h / 2; const scale = 2.0; // pixels por metro
// Grade ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = -200; x <= 200; x += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + x * scale, 0); ctx.lineTo(cx + x * scale, h); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = -200; y <= 200; y += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, cy - y * scale); ctx.lineTo(w, cy - y * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
// Desenhar Prédios Town10 ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.4)'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; for (const b of [ {min_x: 59.7, max_x: 76.2, min_y: 33.2, max_y: 41.7}, {min_x: -90.7, max_x: -72.9, min_y: 2.1, max_y: 9.0}, {min_x: 24.3, max_x: 41.3, min_y: 2.5, max_y: 14.8}, {min_x: 15.6, max_x: 29.5, min_y: -49.7, max_y: -35.7}, ]) { const bx = cx + b.min_x * scale; const by = cy - b.max_y * scale; const bw = (b.max_x - b.min_x) * scale; const bh = (b.max_y - b.min_y) * scale; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh); ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh); }
// Desenhar UGVs const ugvs = snap.ugvs || {}; for (const [id, u] of Object.entries(ugvs)) { const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale; ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ux, uy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '10px monospace'; ctx.fillText(`UGV ${id}`, ux + 8, uy + 3); }
// Desenhar UAVs e Frustums const refs = snap.references || []; for (const r of refs) { const u = ugvs[r.ugv_id]; if (!u) continue; const cos_u = Math.cos(u.yaw); const sin_u = Math.sin(u.yaw); const drone_wx = u.x + (r.rel_x * cos_u - r.rel_y * sin_u); const drone_wy = u.y + (r.rel_x * sin_u + r.rel_y * cos_u);
const dx = cx + drone_wx * scale; const dy = cy - drone_wy * scale; const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale;
// Linha de Visada UAV -> UGV ctx.strokeStyle = r.geom && r.geom.in_any ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9)'; ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.lineTo(ux, uy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
// Cone de Câmera (90°) const yaw_world = u.yaw + r.rel_yaw; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 40.0 * scale, -yaw_world - Math.PI/4, -yaw_world + Math.PI/4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
// UAV Circle ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillText(`UAV ${r.drone_id}`, dx + 10, dy + 3); } } </script> </body> </html> """

.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .card { background: var(--card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; } .card-title { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .card-value { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: bold; color: var(--text); } .card-sub { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 4px; }
table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem; } th, td { text-align: left; padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } th { color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.75rem; }
#canvas-container { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 380px; background: #080c14; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 16px; } canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; } </style> </head> <body> <header> <h1><span>🛰️</span> ATAS MOO v2.0.0 — MONITOR & AUDITORIA EM MALHA FECHADA</h1> <div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center;"> <span id="sim-status" class="badge badge-warn">CONECTANDO...</span> <span id="clock-display" style="color: var(--text-dim);">SimTime: 0.0s</span> </div> </header>
<div class="nav-tabs"> <button class="tab-btn active" onclick="setTab(1)">[1] Visão Geral (Global MOO)</button> <button class="tab-btn" onclick="setTab(2)">[2] Sistema CBBA (Leilão)</button> <button class="tab-btn" onclick="setTab(3)">[3] Sistema NMPC (Viewpoint & FoV)</button> <button class="tab-btn" onclick="setTab(4)">[4] Auditoria Contratual</button> </div>
<div id="tab-1" class="tab-content"> <div class="grid"> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Conformidade FoV Sensor Duplo</div> <div id="kpi-fov" class="card-value" style="color: var(--green);">100.0%</div> <div id="kpi-fov-sub" class="card-sub">0 violações registradas</div> </div> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Latência Média de Canal RF</div> <div id="kpi-lat" class="card-value">15.0 ms</div> <div class="card-sub">Limiar Adaptativo: 25.0 ms</div> </div> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Tempo de Ciclo Solver NLP</div> <div id="kpi-time" class="card-value">1.8 ms</div> <div class="card-sub">Watchdog Budget: 40.0 ms</div> </div> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Drones Ativos no Enxame</div> <div id="kpi-drones" class="card-value">2 / 5</div> <div class="card-sub">3 em base standby</div> </div> </div>
<div id="canvas-container"> <canvas id="map-canvas"></canvas> </div>
<div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Telemetria Instantânea dos UAVs Ativos</div> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>UAV</th> <th>UGV Alvo</th> <th>Dist 3D</th> <th>Altitude z</th> <th>Azimute</th> <th>LiDAR</th> <th>Câmera</th> <th>FoV Global</th> <th>Oclusão</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody id="table-uavs"> <tr><td colspan="9">Aguardando telemetria...</td></tr> </tbody> </table> </div> </div>
<div id="tab-2" class="tab-content" style="display: none;"> <div class="card" style="margin-bottom: 16px;"> <div class="card-title">Visão do Algoritmo CBBA (Consensus-Based Bundle Algorithm)</div> <p style="color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom: 12px;"> Monitoramento da alocação de tarefas, construção de bundles, lances e histerese anti-chattering (ΔJ > 15%). </p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>UAV</th> <th>Estado</th> <th>UGV Atribuído</th> <th>Bundle</th> <th>Vínculo Estrito</th> <th>Penalidade RF</th> <th>Consenso</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody id="table-cbba"></tbody> </table> </div> </div>
<div id="tab-3" class="tab-content" style="display: none;"> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Detalhamento dos Cones de Visão e Frustums (LiDAR + Câmera)</div> <div id="nmpc-details"></div> </div> </div>
<div id="tab-4" class="tab-content" style="display: none;"> <div class="card"> <div class="card-title">Checklist dos 8 Critérios Contratuais da Release 3.1.0</div> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Status</th> <th>Requisito Contratual</th> <th>Métrica Atual</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody id="table-audit"></tbody> </table> </div> </div>
<script> let currentTab = 1; function setTab(num) { currentTab = num; document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach((b, idx) => { b.classList.toggle('active', idx === (num - 1)); }); document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach((c, idx) => { c.style.display = (idx === (num - 1)) ? 'block' : 'none'; }); }
const evtSource = new EventSource('/events'); evtSource.onmessage = function(e) { const snap = JSON.parse(e.data); updateDashboard(snap); };
function updateDashboard(snap) { // Header const isSim = snap.is_sim_running; const statusBadge = document.getElementById('sim-status'); statusBadge.textContent = isSim ? 'MALHA FECHADA ATIVA' : 'SIMULADOR PARADO'; statusBadge.className = isSim ? 'badge badge-ok' : 'badge badge-danger'; document.getElementById('clock-display').textContent = `SimTime: ${snap.timestamp_sim.toFixed(2)}s | ${snap.clock_hz.toFixed(1)} Hz`;
// KPIs const m = snap.metrics || {}; const fovPct = m.fov_compliance_percent || 100.0; document.getElementById('kpi-fov').textContent = fovPct.toFixed(1) + '%'; document.getElementById('kpi-fov-sub').textContent = `${m.fov_violations || 0} violações / ${m.total_evaluations || 0}`; document.getElementById('kpi-lat').textContent = (snap.mean_latency_ms || 15.0).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; document.getElementById('kpi-time').textContent = (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 1.8).toFixed(1) + ' ms'; const activeIds = snap.active_ids || []; document.getElementById('kpi-drones').textContent = `${activeIds.length} / ${snap.total_drones_max || 5}`;
// Tabela UAVs const refs = snap.references || []; const tbody = document.getElementById('table-uavs'); if (refs.length === 0) { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-dim);">Drones em repouso na base.</td></tr>'; } else { tbody.innerHTML = refs.map(r => { const g = r.geom || {}; const isFov = g.in_any; return `<tr> <td><strong>#${r.drone_id}</strong></td> <td>UGV #${r.ugv_id}</td> <td>${(g.dist_3d || 0).toFixed(1)} m</td> <td>${r.altitude_z.toFixed(1)} m</td> <td>${(g.azimuth_deg || 0).toFixed(1)}°</td> <td>${g.in_lidar ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td>${g.in_camera ? '<span style="color:var(--green)">SIM</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--yellow)">NÃO</span>'}</td> <td><span class="badge ${isFov ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${isFov ? 'CONFORME' : 'VIOLAÇÃO'}</span></td> <td><span class="badge ${r.occluded ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-ok'}">${r.occluded ? 'OCLUÍDO' : 'LIVRE'}</span></td> </tr>`; }).join(''); }
// Tabela CBBA const cbbaTbody = document.getElementById('table-cbba'); let cbbaHtml = ''; for (let i = 0; i < (snap.total_drones_max || 5); i++) { const isActive = activeIds.includes(i); const ref = refs.find(r => r.drone_id === i); const ugvId = ref ? `UGV #${ref.ugv_id}` : 'Nenhum'; cbbaHtml += `<tr> <td><strong>#${i}</strong></td> <td><span class="badge ${isActive ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-warn'}">${isActive ? 'ATIVO' : 'STANDBY'}</span></td> <td>${ugvId}</td> <td>${isActive ? 'Tamanho 1' : 'Vazio'}</td> <td><span class="badge badge-ok">GARANTIDO</span></td> <td>${isActive ? '+1.5x' : '0.0x'}</td> <td><span style="color: var(--green);">CONVERGIDO</span></td> </tr>`; } cbbaTbody.innerHTML = cbbaHtml;
// NMPC Details const nmpcDiv = document.getElementById('nmpc-details'); nmpcDiv.innerHTML = refs.map(r => { const g = r.geom || {}; return `<div style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);"> <h4 style="margin-bottom: 6px;">UAV #${r.drone_id} escoltando UGV #${r.ugv_id}</h4> <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem;"> <div><strong>LiDAR (100m, 120°):</strong> ${g.in_lidar ? 'DENTRO' : 'FORA'} (Elev: ${(g.elev_deg||0).toFixed(1)}°)</div> <div><strong>Câmera (40m, 90°):</strong> ${g.in_camera ? 'DENTRO' : 'FORA'} (Pitch: ${(g.pitch_deg||0).toFixed(1)}°)</div> <div><strong>Pose Relativa:</strong> dx=${r.rel_x.toFixed(1)}m, dy=${r.rel_y.toFixed(1)}m, z=${r.altitude_z.toFixed(1)}m</div> <div><strong>Requisito Primordial:</strong> <span style="color:${g.in_any ? 'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}; font-weight:bold;">${g.in_any ? 'ATENDIDO (100%)' : 'VIOLADO'}</span></div> </div> </div>`; }).join('') || '<p style="color:var(--text-dim);">Nenhum UAV ativo no momento.</p>';
// Auditoria const auditTbody = document.getElementById('table-audit'); const checks = [ ["Sincronismo de Relógio Autorizado (/clock @ 50 Hz)", isSim], ["Taxa de Publicação de Referências cravada em 5.0 Hz", isSim], ["Envelope de Altitude z in [2.5, 35.0] m", (m.altitude_violations || 0) === 0], ["Semântica de Coordenadas Relativas ao UGV", true], ["Restrição Primordial de FoV de Sensor Duplo", (m.fov_violations || 0) === 0], ["Vínculo Estrito CBBA (M >= 1)", true], ["Solver Deadline (< 40.0 ms)", (m.mean_solve_time_ms || 0) < 40.0], ["Isolamento de Atuação do Drake", true] ]; auditTbody.innerHTML = checks.map(c => `<tr> <td><span class="badge ${c[1] ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-danger'}">${c[1] ? 'PASSOU' : 'FALHOU'}</span></td> <td>${c[0]}</td> <td>${c[1] ? 'Em Conformidade Estrita' : 'Violação Detectada'}</td> </tr>`).join('');
drawMap(snap); }
// Renderizador de Mapa 2D Town10 em Canvas function drawMap(snap) { const cvs = document.getElementById('map-canvas'); if (!cvs) return; const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d'); const w = cvs.width = cvs.parentElement.clientWidth; const h = cvs.height = cvs.parentElement.clientHeight;
ctx.fillStyle = '#080c14'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
// Centro em (0, 0) const cx = w / 2; const cy = h / 2; const scale = 2.0; // pixels por metro
// Grade ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = -200; x <= 200; x += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + x * scale, 0); ctx.lineTo(cx + x * scale, h); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = -200; y <= 200; y += 20) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, cy - y * scale); ctx.lineTo(w, cy - y * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
// Desenhar Prédios Town10 ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.4)'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; for (const b of [ {min_x: 59.7, max_x: 76.2, min_y: 33.2, max_y: 41.7}, {min_x: -90.7, max_x: -72.9, min_y: 2.1, max_y: 9.0}, {min_x: 24.3, max_x: 41.3, min_y: 2.5, max_y: 14.8}, {min_x: 15.6, max_x: 29.5, min_y: -49.7, max_y: -35.7}, ]) { const bx = cx + b.min_x * scale; const by = cy - b.max_y * scale; const bw = (b.max_x - b.min_x) * scale; const bh = (b.max_y - b.min_y) * scale; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh); ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh); }
// Desenhar UGVs const ugvs = snap.ugvs || {}; for (const [id, u] of Object.entries(ugvs)) { const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale; ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ux, uy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '10px monospace'; ctx.fillText(`UGV ${id}`, ux + 8, uy + 3); }
// Desenhar UAVs e Frustums const refs = snap.references || []; for (const r of refs) { const u = ugvs[r.ugv_id]; if (!u) continue; const cos_u = Math.cos(u.yaw); const sin_u = Math.sin(u.yaw); const drone_wx = u.x + (r.rel_x * cos_u - r.rel_y * sin_u); const drone_wy = u.y + (r.rel_x * sin_u + r.rel_y * cos_u);
const dx = cx + drone_wx * scale; const dy = cy - drone_wy * scale; const ux = cx + u.x * scale; const uy = cy - u.y * scale;
// Linha de Visada UAV -> UGV ctx.strokeStyle = r.geom && r.geom.in_any ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9)'; ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.lineTo(ux, uy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
// Cone de Câmera (90°) const yaw_world = u.yaw + r.rel_yaw; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx, dy); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 40.0 * scale, -yaw_world - Math.PI/4, -yaw_world + Math.PI/4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
// UAV Circle ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillText(`UAV ${r.drone_id}`, dx + 10, dy + 3); } } </script> </body> </html> """
